OptiCore Cleaner 3.0.0 is the first release under the new name: a small, native Windows app that finds and frees wasted disk space, with a preview before anything is deleted.

**Download OptiCore Cleaner:** [Windows (64-bit)](https://github.com/ladroxd/TempCleanerV2/releases/download/v3.0.0/OptiCore-Cleaner.exe) · [SHA-256 checksum](https://github.com/ladroxd/TempCleanerV2/releases/download/v3.0.0/OptiCore-Cleaner.exe.sha256)

No installer: download it and run it. Windows SmartScreen may warn that the app isn't recognised, because it isn't code-signed. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

## New

- **Three ways to clean.** Quick Scan shows how much space you can free without deleting anything, Complete Cleanup removes all system junk in one click, and Custom Cleanup lets you pick exactly what goes.
- **Clean Now after a scan.** When Quick Scan finds something, the same button removes it.
- **Sizes before you clean.** Custom Cleanup measures every item in the background, shows its size and adds up what you've ticked. Your selection is remembered.
- **Much more to clean.** Windows Update leftovers, Delivery Optimization files, error reports, crash dumps, Windows logs, the thumbnail cache, Store app temp files, other accounts' temp folders, and the Recycle Bin.
- **Browser, app and game caches.** Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, Opera, Firefox, Discord, and DirectX, NVIDIA and AMD shader caches. These are only cleaned when you tick them in Custom Cleanup, so your games and browsers aren't slowed down by surprise.
- **Windows component cleanup.** An advanced, admin-only option that runs DISM to remove old Windows Update components, often freeing several GB.
- **Weekly automatic cleanup.** Options → Schedule weekly cleanup runs Complete Cleanup every Sunday in the background and shows a notification when it's done.
- **Exclusions.** Pick folders OptiCore must never touch.
- **Recent temp files are kept.** Files from the last 24 hours are left alone by default, so running installers aren't broken.
- **Progress and results.** A progress bar while cleaning, and a summary with the space freed and the free space on your drive before and after.
- **Dark mode.** Follows your Windows setting, or pick Light or Dark yourself.
- **Stop at any time.** The Stop button, or closing the window, ends a clean safely at the next file.
- **Log tools and updates.** Copy or save the log, and check for new versions from the Help menu.

## Good to know

- Run it as administrator (there's a button for it) to clean system folders. Without admin rights those items are mostly skipped.
- Files that are in use are skipped and counted in the summary. Close your browsers before cleaning their caches.
- For scripts, `OptiCore-Cleaner.exe /auto` runs Complete Cleanup without a window.
